en_content:
Main Job Websites in Ireland

http://www.IrishJobs.ie: One of the largest job portals in Ireland.http://www.Jobs.ie: Vacancies across many areas, great for all kinds of professionals.http://www.Indeed.ie: It gathers many vacancies from different sources, with useful filters.http://www.Monster.ie: Another comprehensive site for finding opportunities.http://www.RecruitIreland.com: Focused on recruitment in Ireland.http://www.JobsIreland.ie: A useful platform for your job search. 

💼 WHERE TO LOOK FOR WORK IN LAOIS

 

🧑‍💻 Job sites used in Ireland

These sites are used by companies in Ireland (including vacancies in Laois). You can filter by town/county:

 

🌐 Indeed – https://ie.indeed.com/jobs?q=&l=Laois

→ One of the sites with the most vacancies in Laois and across Ireland, including part-time and full-time. 

Indeed

​

🌐 IrishJobs.ie – https://www.irishjobs.ie/

→ Plenty of job offers across various sectors. 

Oi.ie – Brazilians in Ireland

 

🌐 Jobs.ie – https://www.jobs.ie/

→ Filter by location and type of work. 

Oi.ie – Brazilians in Ireland

 

🌐 RecruitIreland.com

→ Another site with plenty of vacancies by category.

💡 Useful apps for finding work:

IrishJobs App

Jobs.ie App

LinkedIn Jobs

Indeed App

… and other job apps that show vacancies straight on your phone. 

novavidanairlanda.com

 

🏙️ Public services and local support

📍 Intreo – Public employment service

It is the Irish government's official employment and social support service.

You can: 

✔ get help looking for work

✔ get advice on CVs and interviews

✔ find out about benefits and supports

👉 Find out more at the Intreo office in Portlaoise (part of the DSP – Department of Social Protection) or on the official website. 

laois.ie

 

📍 Turas Nua

An Intreo partner organisation that helps people find work locally, with personalised support and connections with employers. 

Laois Jobs Fair

 

📍 SICAP / Laois Partnership Company

An employment support programme that helps with: 

✔ professional training

✔ putting together a CV

✔ connecting you with jobs and courses

Phone: 057 8661900 (information and services) 

laois.ie

 

📅 Job fairs and events

🔹 Laois Jobs Fair – an event where several companies offer vacancies, training information and professional support. 

Even if the main event has already passed, note that it is organised regularly and is a great place to meet employers and discover opportunities.

Laois Jobs Fair

 

📱 FACEBOOK GROUPS / COMMUNITIES FOR JOB HUNTING

There are groups where workers and companies post vacancies and tips. Common examples (search on Facebook):

➡ Jobs in Ireland / Vacancies in Ireland

➡ Jobs in Laois / Vacancies in Laois (or Midlands Ireland Jobs)

➡ Irish Jobs – Hospitality & Retail

➡ Irish Jobs – Part Time & Full Time

🔎 Simply search Facebook for terms such as:

“Jobs in Laois”, “Jobs Ireland”, “Laois Jobs”, “Ireland Work”, etc.

💡 Tip: comment or ask for a referral — sometimes new vacancies appear in groups before they reach official sites.

 

📱 WHATSAPP / TELEGRAM GROUPS

WhatsApp or Telegram groups are usually unofficial and change often, but you can find invitations in the Facebook groups or by asking on Brazilian community pages in Ireland.

👉 Look for groups such as:

“Brazilians in Ireland – Jobs”

“Brazilians in Laois”

“Jobs Ireland – Hospitality / Retail”

“Job Alerts Ireland”

These groups usually share daily vacancies and employer recommendations.

 

🧠 TIPS TO BOOST YOUR CHANCES

 

✔ Have a CV adapted for Ireland:

No photo, with recent experience and references. 

Oi.ie – Brazilians in Ireland

✔ Upload your CV to the job sites:

Many recruiters look for candidates directly there.

✔ Visit shops and businesses in person:

Handing in your CV can make all the difference.

✔ Talk to local recruiters:

Such as FRS Recruitment, Sigmar Recruitment, Staffline Ireland and others — they often have vacancies that never appear online. 

novavidanairlanda.com

✔ Look for temporary work (hospitality / retail):

These sectors often hire more quickly.

✔️Let the local groups (WhatsApp, Facebook) know that you are looking for work. This helps with local recommendations.
